scope: Second preregistered neural open-loop screen of round 12: re-weight ONLY existing edges that run between the two tripod groups (A = LF,RM,LH and B = RF,LM,RH), separately for each direction and receptor type, with per-row renormalisation to the frozen 0.020 uS. No physics, no readout learning, no acceptance change, no new edges, no external oscillator, no descending drive.
why: Screen 1 (../PREREG.json) re-weighted the coarse leg-pair classes and could not produce tripod anti-phase (best tripod score -0.316, threshold +0.30, 124 combinations). The classic mechanism that turns mutual inhibition into alternation is a half-centre: reciprocal inhibition between the two groups plus spike-frequency adaptation, which this module already has as the -80 mV adaptation conductance. Screen 2 therefore targets the A<->B edges directly, separately per direction and receptor, which screen 1 could not express because its classes mixed directions and receptors.

group_definition.neuron_leg_tag: leg of the direct-MN-projecting premotor pool for buckets pool_lf..pool_rm; leg of the motor neuron for the 323 MNs; untagged for shared, nonmotor and other MNs outside the 323

classes.cross_AB_inh: pre tagged A, post tagged B, inhibitory (GABA/glutamate)
classes.cross_AB_exc: pre tagged A, post tagged B, excitatory (acetylcholine)
classes.cross_BA_inh: pre tagged B, post tagged A, inhibitory
classes.cross_BA_exc: pre tagged B, post tagged A, excitatory

grid.rule: complete factorial over (inh_AB, inh_BA, exc_AB, exc_BA); every combination run and reported; no pruning

protocol: Identical to screen 1: restore the canonical 2000-step state, replay the 100 recorded sensory bins cyclically for 400 bins (2000 ms), zero descending current, record the 323 exported MN filtered rates every 5 ms. Physical steps 0.
fixed_analysis: Identical metric definitions to screen 1 and round-11 intrinsic so numbers stay comparable: tripod alternation score = -corr(mean(A), mean(B)); ipsilateral score; LF-RH and RF-LH correlations; per-leg means; PC1 variance fraction and loadings.
decision_rule_fixed_in_advance: ALTERNATION-POSITIVE only if tripod score >= 0.30, both group mean rates > 2 Hz, and both LF-RH and RF-LH correlations are negative. A positive result licenses only a further preregistered physical experiment; it is not walking and not a biological claim. All-negative must be reported as negative with no reframing.
guards: With every scalar 1 the rebuilt matrices must equal the frozen ones exactly and the network behaviour must be bit-identical to the frozen core before any grid run.
headroom_known_in_advance: The A<->B edge classes are a small share of total conductance (screen-1 class tripod_diagonal was 0.1348 uS of 380.84 uS), so a null is plausible; row renormalisation means large scalars can re-allocate a row's 0.020 uS budget rather than increase it.
limits: Open-loop neural replay only, no body, no contact, no sensorimotor loop. Scalars are uncalibrated engineering weights; the half-centre mechanism is a modelling hypothesis here, not a measurement of fly circuitry; the strict 20k subgraph is not the whole VNC. Nothing here is a lesion or surgical model.
